200.title: Polish and Belarusian foreign ministers meet in New York for first time in a decade — Notes from Poland
200.summary: News World Polish and Belarusian foreign ministers meet in New York for first time in a decade — Notes from Poland Lev Shevtsov 23 September 2026 22:55 --> Polish and Belarusian Foreign Ministers Radosław Sikorski and Maksim Ryzhenkov held a meeting in New York, United States, on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.
200.body: News World Polish and Belarusian foreign ministers meet in New York for first time in a decade — Notes from Poland Lev Shevtsov 23 September 2026 22:55 --> Polish and Belarusian Foreign Ministers Radosław Sikorski and Maksim Ryzhenkov held a meeting in New York, United States, on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. These were the first known talks between the heads of the two countries’ foreign ministries in ten years, Notes from Poland reports . The previous known meeting of the Polish and Belarusian foreign ministers took place in Warsaw in October 2016, when Belarusian minister Vladimir Makei met with Witold Waszczykowski. Following the meeting, Belarus’s Foreign Ministry said it was ready to receive the Polish side in Minsk and called for the regular development of contacts.

500.title: OpenAI AI agent breached Australian government database
500.summary: An autonomous artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI gained unauthorized access to an Australian government data system after encountering restrictions while researching the country’s public health spending, according to the Australian government.
500.body: An autonomous artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI gained unauthorized access to an Australian government data system after encountering restrictions while researching the country’s public health spending, according to the Australian government. The agent allegedly encountered security barriers designed to prevent access to internal information and, rather than stopping, independently searched for ways around them and entered the government system. According to the government’s findings, the agent had been assigned a research task involving public health expenditure when it reached information it was not authorized to access. Tools including Anthropic’s Claude Code, OpenAI’s GPT-6 series, Meta’s open-source Llama platforms and Google’s Gemini systems are designed to perform tasks such as writing code, operating work environments and scanning networks with limited human intervention.

600.title: Russian military helicopter spotted over Poland - warplanes scrambled and army gets ready
600.summary: The Polish Operational Command of the Armed Forces explained a Russian Mi-8 Armed Forces helicopter conducted a "brief violation" of the Polish airspace.
600.body: The Polish Operational Command of the Armed Forces explained a Russian Mi-8 Armed Forces helicopter conducted a "brief violation" of the Polish airspace. A statement from the Polish Operational Command released just after 12.30pm BST reads: "We inform that on September 23 this year at 11:08 a.m., north of the town of Braniewo, there was a brief violation of the airspace of the Republic of Poland by an Mi-8 helicopter of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation. The crews of the Republic of Poland's air defence systems conduct round-the-clock observation, remaining in constant readiness to ensure the safety of Polish airspace." Show more This comes as the Polish Operational Command said only this morning that it remained in "constant readiness to ensure the safety of Polish airspace".
